title: Friday Quick Tip
subtitle: Practice in a small gym
hook: Practice moved indoors to half a gym. Now what?
intro: You have a small gym and twelve kids.
statement: A small space can be a chance to work on close skills.
q1: Do you change the plan to fit the space —
q2: or run your usual drills in smaller groups?
q3: What skills need only a small space?
t1: There is no perfect answer here. But indoor days work
t2: when the plan fits the room.
cta: Coaches — how do you practice indoors?
ctaLines: Glove work. Soft toss into a net. Stations along the wall.
New plan or the usual one?
ctaPrompt: Share your indoor habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
Practice moved indoors to half a gym. Now what?
The field is frozen. You have a small gym and twelve kids.
A small space can be a chance to work on close skills.
A new plan or the usual drills in smaller groups. Both can work.
How do you practice indoors? Share your habit in the comments.
